BestTime.description: "Best time to call" on the Contact form (optional).
BestTime.title: BestTime

ConsultationStatus.description: The call-back workflow (Figma 04–05). Only TransitionConsultationStatus changes a request's status; the client never sets it directly. "Overdue" is not a status: it is a new request past its follow-up time.
ConsultationStatus.title: ConsultationStatus

ConsultationTopic.description: "How can we help?" on the Contact form. Stored as the value, shown as the label.
ConsultationTopic.title: ConsultationTopic

ContactMethod.description: "Preferred method of communication" on the qualification form.
ContactMethod.title: ContactMethod

permissions.description: A Super Admin holds every key, listed so the SPA needs no wildcard rule.

available.description: The site-wide switch; while it is off sign-in never asks for a code.

email.description: Removed accounts keep their email, so it cannot be reused by mistake.

PageTemplate.description: Starting layouts for new pages (Figma 06 "Template" column).
PageTemplate.title: PageTemplate

PriorTreatment.description: "Have you tried therapy and antidepressants?" on the qualification form. Health information: stored encrypted as the value, shown as the label.
PriorTreatment.title: PriorTreatment

ReviewState.description: The "Clinical review" column of Figma 11, derived from the post.
ReviewState.title: ReviewState

SavePostRequest.description: The editor's working copy (autosave and Save draft). Drafts may be incomplete; Publish checks completeness.
SavePostRequest.title: SavePostRequest

SaveSeoMetaRequest.description:
The SEO, Social and Schema tabs send any subset of these. Scores are
never accepted from the client; the server computes them.
SaveSeoMetaRequest.title: SaveSeoMetaRequest

SeoSettings.description:
Site-wide SEO defaults (Figma 23): title templates, the default share
image, social handle, verification codes, the Google Tag Manager
container, sitemap and robots.txt options. Grouped by the screen's tabs;
missing keys read as defaults.
SeoSettings.title: SeoSettings

SubmitConsultationRequestRequest.description:
The website's "Find out if you qualify for TMS" form (Contact page and
the Home hero's popup), posted by the Next.js server. Laravel is the
one validator; the site mirrors these rules for instant feedback. Error
messages speak to the patient.

anyOf.description: Optional: a self-check result links here with its topic.

website.description: Honeypot: people never see this field.

SubmitConsultationRequestRequest.title: SubmitConsultationRequestRequest

SubmitQuizRequest.description:
The website's self-check (docs/QUIZ.md), posted by the Next.js server.
Only the envelope is checked here: QuizFlow checks every answer against
the published quiz and scores it.

website.description: Honeypot: people never see this field.

SubmitQuizRequest.title: SubmitQuizRequest

route binding has already limited `{consultation}` to the caller's scope.
UpdateConsultationRequestRequest.title: UpdateConsultationRequestRequest

file.description: The type is read from the file's bytes, not its name.
